0001112223331021320302 - ASI: 20

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  02 = 0 * 2
  03 = 0 * 3
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  22 = 2 * 2
  31 = 3 * 1
  32 = 3 * 2
  33 = 3 * 3
  000 = 0 * 00
  132 = 1 * 32
  0302 = 03 * 02
  2233 = 22 * 33
  3102 = 31 * 02
  00011 = 000 * 11
  122233 = 12 * 2233
  3102132 = 3102 * 132
  00011122233 = 00011 * 122233
  31021320302 = 3102132 * 0302
  0001112223331021320302 = 00011122233 * 31021320302
